messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — planned maintenance for runtime binaries and dedicated pinning on 2026-03-23 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need a customer-facing status page blurb + email template. Can someone draft?

Priya Rao: I can draft the statuspage blurb. Will we be doing a canary first or direct rollout?

Oliver Park: Canary on a small pool, then 20% -> 50% -> 100%. If latency/regressions show, we hold and roll back to pin v2026-03-15-2. I will pin that version in config as fallback.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Also include a line about potential brief degraded throughput for dedicated customers during the window.

deploy-bot: Maintenance event scheduled: id=maint-20260323-01, window=2026-03-23T02:00:00Z/2026-03-23T03:00:00Z, targets=[runtime-binaries, dedicated-pools]. Automation will create canary and rollout jobs at +5m/+20m/+40m.

statusbot: Draft status page update created (preview link: https://status.redwood.example/drafts/maint-20260323-01).

Samir Patel: Pasting suggested short status page blurb below — keep it customer-facing and non-technical:

```
Title: Planned maintenance — inference runtime update
Window: 2026-03-23 02:00–03:00 UTC
Impact: Some customers may experience brief increases in request latency or reduced throughput on Dedicated capacity while we apply an important runtime update. API requests will remain available and we will roll back if we detect regressions.
What we're doing: Applying an optimized runtime binary and pinning a stable fallback version to ensure quick rollback if needed.
Status: We will post updates here and via email.
```

Maya Chen: Nice. Can someone add the customer email subject + 2 short body variants (concise + detailed)? We'll use concise for high-traffic customers and detailed for enterprise.

Oliver Park: Concise version: 

```
Subject: Planned maintenance — short impact window (Mar 23 UTC)
Body: We're performing a planned update to our inference runtime on Mar 23 from 02:00–03:00 UTC. You may see brief latency or reduced throughput on Dedicated capacity. No action required. We'll notify if rollback occurs.
```

Oliver Park: Detailed version (enterprise):

```
Subject: Planned maintenance: runtime update and dedicated capacity pinning (Mar 23)
Body: Dear customer,
We're deploying an optimized runtime binary to improve inference stability and cost for long-running workloads on Mar 23, 02:00–03:00 UTC. During the rollout we will:
- Perform a canary on a small subset of Dedicated pools, followed by staged rollout.
- Pin a verified fallback version (v2026-03-15-2) to allow immediate rollback if we detect latency or correctness regressions.
Potential impact: brief increases in request latency or reduced throughput; API endpoints will remain reachable. If you have strict SLAs, please reach out and we can coordinate a maintenance-exempt plan.
Regards,
Redwood Support
```

Priya Rao: Add a single-sentence note for the status page about rollback criteria: "If error rate or P95 latency exceeds our SLO thresholds for more than 3 consecutive minutes during canary, we will halt and roll back."

Samir Patel: Done — added to the status draft. Also flagged dedicated customers with >1k RPS for targeted email.

Maya Chen: Great. Action items: Oliver — pin fallback and be ready to roll back; Priya — publish status page draft and schedule email segments; Samir — run targeted list and QA the email send. I'll handle the customer-facing Slack/Discord note.

Oliver Park: On it. I will push the pin config now and post a short follow-up once pinned.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 2026-03-23T02:05:00Z for maint-20260323-01 (canary pool: dp-3).

Maya Chen: Thanks team — keep updates minimal here, post important status changes to the status page._emoji_:thumbsup:
